title: Academic Opinion Essay: Balancing Breadth and Depth in University Study
prompt: Some people argue that university students should be required to study a broad range of subjects across different disciplines, while others believe they should focus narrowly on one specialised field in order to develop genuine expertise. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. In your essay, state which position you find more convincing and explain the reasons for your view, supporting your argument with relevant examples from education or professional life. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟学术写作练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先仔细阅读题目，明确题目要求你讨论的两种观点（广泛学习多学科 vs. 专注单一专业）以及你必须给出的个人立场。写作时请做到：1）引言段清晰改写题目并表明自己的总体立场；2）主体段分别讨论双方观点，说明其理由与局限，可用教育或职业领域的例子支撑；3）明确论证你更认同哪一方，并解释原因；4）结论段总结立场，不引入全新论点。全文不少于250词，注意段落衔接、论证逻辑与学术语体，避免仅罗列观点而缺少分析。
